instruction.text: Watch what happens when two boxes of the same mass slide down a ramp.

atoms.a: Which box has friction had a stronger effect on?

atoms.b: Since friction is produced when two surfaces ((++touch freeze)), the bigger the surface area of the object, the more ((++friction speed)) will be produced.

trainers.instruction: If both objects have the same mass, which will friction have less of an effect on?

feedback.end: Since the ball is round, the amount of it in contact with the floor is quite small. This means it is less affected by friction.

atoms.a: Why would friction affect the ball less than the pot?
b: ++It has a smaller surface area in contact with the floor.
It has a larger surface area in contact with the floor.

trainers.instruction: If both objects have the same mass, which will friction have more of an effect on?

feedback.end: The trainer’s sole has a larger surface area, so friction will have a stronger effect.

atoms.a: Why would friction affect the trainer more than the high-heel?
b: It is a lighter shade of blue.
++Its sole has more contact with the floor.
Its sole has a smaller surface area than the high-heel.

instruction.text: All of these objects have the same mass. Considering their surface area, put them into order of how much they will be affected by friction, starting with the least affected at the top.
